catalogPolicy: A reviewed application update changes the supported catalog. GET /models validates credentials and currently available supported IDs; remote metadata cannot add origins, capabilities, tools or models to the application allowlist. Image input is provider capability data; the first native journey is text only.
request: Persisted selection must use providerID deepseek and a supported model. Serialize original message roles, full reasoning_content, tool call IDs/names/arguments and tool results without flattening. Reject unsupported attachments instead of dropping them. stream=true, stream_options.include_usage=true, explicit max_tokens. Off sets thinking.type=disabled and omits reasoning_effort; all other efforts set thinking.type=enabled with their exact low/high/max value. No server search/fetch, Responses background work, automatic retries or autonomous tool loop.
transport: An isolated TLS client sends Authorization only to the fixed origin and fixed paths. Deny all redirects, disable cookies/caches/logging/automatic retries and redact all diagnostics. Do not activate provider calls in tests; use fakes. GET /models validates setup without starting model inference. A user explicitly sends each chat request using their own provider account.
stream: Parse incremental bytes without corrupting split UTF-8 characters. Accept LF/CRLF, comments and standard multi-line data fields. Require a valid finish reason and the terminating [DONE] event; EOF alone is not success. Preserve reasoning separately, assemble indexed tool fragments with original IDs, enforce aggregate bounds and maxToolCalls, validate usage counters. stop=end; length=outputLimit; tool_calls=toolCalls only with valid bounded calls. content_filter, insufficient_system_resource, aborted and unknown finish reasons fail safely. Never execute tool arguments while decoding.
conversation: DeepSeek journals are separate from existing local conversations. Consent names DeepSeek and the transmitted conversation. The UI identifies destination, model, effort and tool execution location; initial UI tools are disabled. Cancellation/error/output limit retains visible partial output but does not silently make an incomplete turn eligible for later provider history. Stop cancels the local request; it does not prove a provider billing or remote Host stop receipt. Relaunch never automatically resumes a request.
credentials: Apple Keychain or Android Keystore-backed encrypted storage holds the key; a profile stores only an opaque qcred reference. Never serialize credentials into conversation state, logs, bundles, exports, reports or screenshots. Key removal stops new work without deleting conversations. Cross-origin credentials and arbitrary API endpoints are prohibited.
verification: Both native suites execute the same shared/deepseek-provider-fixtures.json cases and emit DEEPSEEK_FIXTURE_PASS <id> only after assertions. Fixed transport/vault failure tests supplement shared fixtures. Live inference, secure-storage integration in signed apps and rendered journeys remain separate release gates. Application limits are not a provider-enforced financial ceiling. No Quenderin-funded API, search/fetch, relay or other variable-cost service is activated by this increment.
